look_here_first: Do not stop at the white petals. Confirm with glaucous foliage plus bud, sepal-horn, and mature capsule armature because Argemone albiflora subsp. texana can look very similar in flower.

lookalikes.differences: A. polyanthemos overlaps strongly with A. albiflora subsp. texana in white flower color and yellow latex; use leaf, bud, sepal-horn, and capsule characters rather than flower color alone.
